source_text: Cum perfectio consecuta fuerit, delectabit rudimentorum pertulisse molestias. Ita in sanctis litteris.
pass_a_gloss: When perfection followed will-have-been, it-will-delight of-rudiments to-have-borne troubles. So in holy letters.
pass_b_english: When perfection has followed, it will delight us to have borne the rudiments’ trouble — so also in the holy writings.
